detail: Wide annual series (55 years, one row per year) of bird arrival/laying dates per species plus climate indices; no repeated grouping column (#23 wide-repeated-measures rule).
Wide annual series of Hawaiian waterbird abundance (one row per year, species in separate columns) vs rainfall; no grouping column.
Wide annual series (41 years) of Ythan estuary bird counts, crop areas and nitrate, one row per year, many empty Unnamed columns; no grouping column.

Boreal-forest point data, one row per point; the model is a spatial regression (boreal index vs NDVI) with correlation structure, the only candidate grouping is the x/y coordinates (besag.checks rule). point is a row id.
Wild-boar TB logistic-regression example, one row per boar (Tb vs length/sex/age); no repeated cluster.
Loyn forest-bird multiple regression, one row per site (ABUND vs area, distance, grazing); no repeated grouping. Unnamed:8/9 empty.
Nereis factorial experiment (concentration ~ nutrient x biomass) with replication but no block/replicate column; the treatment factors are predictors of interest, not sampled clusters (#23).
Amphibian road-kill Poisson GAM, one row per road sector (52) with x/y coordinates; the only candidate grouping is coordinates. Sector a row id.
Irish-rivers pH/SDI data, one row per river (ID/Rivername unique, 210 sites sampled once); no repeated cluster. Easting/Northing coordinates. (Same data as zuur_zim IrishPh.)
Deer/boar TB per estate, one row per farm (32); a binomial GLM on the farm-level proportion infected, the farm being the observational unit, not a repeated cluster.
NA-removed subset of BadgersFarmSurveys.txt (273 of 288 rows, 21 of 27 columns).
Byte-identical copy of Seals.txt (98 rows, same 10 columns and values); a working-name duplicate within the source.
Byte-identical copy of Squid.txt (769 rows, same 5 columns and values).
Deep-sea fish (Bailey et al. 2008) negative-binomial GLM, one row per site (148); TotAbund vs depth and period with offset(log(SweptArea)), no repeated cluster. Dens derived, Xkm/Ykm coordinates.

Acaricide dose-response bioassay, one row per dish (ID unique); binomial GLM cbind(Dead_mites, Total-Dead_mites) ~ concentration + acaricide, no clustering column (an observation-level effect is no grouping factor).
Red-squirrel cone-stripping NB GLM, one row per site (Id unique string like Abern1); SqCones vs tree density/size, no separate grouping column.
Two columns only (Parasites count, CellSize) with one row per bee; no grouping column. (The hive-labelled version is WBees.txt.)
Two-column sheet (a parasite count and cell size, header read as data), one row per bee; no grouping column.
Two-column sheet (a parasite count and cell size, header read as data), one row per bee; no grouping column.
Two-column sheet (a parasite count and cell size, header read as data), one row per bee; no grouping column.
Crocodile survival logistic regression, one row per crocodile (id unique); Survived01 vs delta weight, assistance and position, no repeated cluster. Survived/Survived01 are the same response.
Irish-rivers pH/SDI data, one row per river (210 sites sampled once); no repeated cluster. Easting/Northing coordinates. (Same data as zuur_mixed SDI2003.)
Crayfish length-weight data (CTL, Weight, Sex), one row per crayfish (320); a regression with no grouping column. Unnamed:3 empty.
Great Barrier Reef shark longline sets, one row per set; a zero-inflated count model with Zoning (management zone, the predictor of interest) and lat/long coordinates, no sampled clustering column.
